extDescription.message: Add the sites you open to the Phantom app's Smart VPN list in one click.

menuAddLink.message: Add link's site to Smart VPN

permText.message: The extension needs access to 127.0.0.1, where the Phantom app on this computer listens for it. It talks to nothing else.

noAppText.message: Start Phantom on this computer. "Browser extension" must be on in its settings.

pairText.message: The app will ask you to confirm — so no website can do this on your behalf.

pairingText.message: Phantom is showing a request. Allow it if it shows this same code:

noSiteText.message: This tab isn't a website. Open a site and click the Phantom icon again.

serviceNote.message: This is {name}: all its domains ({n}) will be added, so video and images work too.

afterAdd.message: Done. Open connections will switch over in a couple of seconds.

noteSmartOff.message: Smart VPN is off — listed sites currently go direct.

noteAuto.message: "Pick the best" is on: all traffic already goes through the VPN.

failedTitle.message: Failed to load on this page

failedOffText.message: Site opened but without video or images? They usually live on another domain that is blocked too.

failedJustEnabled.message: Done. Reload the page and the domains that failed will show up here.
